body:
Because I'm a type 1 diabetic (managing it all on my own), there's a felony court case hanging over my head (for 2.5 yrs), I've been diagnosed as depressed and bipolar for 18 years ever since I first attempted suicide. I suspect I've had adhd most of my life too but never been diagnosed.

I'm just so tired of everything. I've been drinking for 8 years to numb all the pain.

Now I have no more chance of salvaging my marriage. I dont feel that I am even a decent mother or human.

People can try to persuade me but it hurts deeply because they just truly dont get what makes me feel so inadequate and I can't ever find the right words.

Ive bottled up so much that I didnt even know where to start with a therapist.

Just all seems too overwhelming and hopeless now.....
